tasks.short: Present a buyer's offer to the seller and record the answer.

steps.what: Extract price, dates and conditions from the buyer's bid.

loop.input: Buyer bid PDF or mail plus the listing record
loop.output: Offer summary fields: price, completion date, financing clause, conditions
loop.check: Agent checks each filled field against the bid
loop.stop: One pass; blank fields stay for the agent to type
loop.why_not_simpler: Bids mix a form with free-text conditions a fixed map misses

steps.what: Check the summary against listing conditions and client identity.
Present that offer version to the seller in the meeting.
Write the seller's answer and send the checked note.

loop.input: Meeting notes and the checked offer version
loop.check: Agent edits every term before send
loop.stop: One draft; a term that is not in the notes is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow what was said, which is not a form

tasks.design: The {CRM} extracts an offer summary from the bid and the listing. The agent checks conditions and identity, then presents that version to the seller. A response note is drafted from the meeting and sent only after the agent edits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Offers arrived as mail and documents, so every pack was retyped before the seller meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Listing fields and a bid file are enough to fill the structured lines. The meeting stays.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing which condition the seller will actually move, and saying the risk plainly.
tasks.human_edge: The agent reads the room and chooses which term to explain first.

ambition.what: The agent decides the same day whether an offer is complete enough to present, instead of waiting to retype the bid.

tasks.altitude: Offer meetings stay on the week. The agent can refuse to present a version that failed the condition check.

reach.task: Set which offer conditions the agency will not change
reach.learn: The broker's non-negotiable conditions before the meeting

evidence.claim: A brokerage system fills a purchase agreement from CRM data and can send it for signature.
Presenting, negotiating and selling stay with a person.
Dutch makelaars are Wwft institutions and must identify the client.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent who presents the offer. Boundary: from a received buyer bid to the seller's recorded answer. Drawing the deed is out of scope.
Structured fields are price, completion date, financing clause, and named conditions. The buyer side produces the bid. Fallback: the agent types any field the extract leaves blank.
Use the {CRM} document template before custom code. {CRM} runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers checklist and template changes when standard conditions change.
Identity checks follow the Dutch Wwft rule named in the digest. Other employment rules are national rules.
unknowns: Whether this brokerage's {CRM} already has an offer template.
Whether the agent on a typical file represents the seller or the buyer.
research_questions: What share of bids arrive as a structured portal form rather than a free-text document?
How often does the seller decide in the first meeting?

incremental.description: Revise the offer checklist and summary template when standard conditions change

approvals.approved_version: checked offer version presented in the meeting
seller response note the agent edited

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most bids are nonstandard, so extraction fails and the meeting is unchanged. High: standard bids, a short check, and the same meeting. The meeting is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Negotiate between buyer and seller for the side the agent represents.

steps.what: Pull each side's latest position from the file and the mail.
Mark which open points the agent may trade.
Negotiate between buyers and sellers on open points.
Restate agreed and open points and send them.

loop.input: The agent's notes of concessions just made
loop.check: Agent confirms each concession matches the client's limit
loop.stop: One draft; if a concession exceeds the limit the send stops
loop.why_not_simpler: Concessions are spoken in the moment and are not a stored form

steps.what: Take a new instruction when the client must move a limit.

tasks.design: The {CRM} shows the last positions. The agent sets trade limits, negotiates live, and sends an agreed-points note only within those limits. A new client instruction is still a call.
tasks.previous_blocker: Positions lived in mail threads, so the agent reconstructed them before every call.
tasks.enabler_now: A {CRM} activity list can show the last position. The trade itself cannot be scripted.
tasks.still_hard: Trading a term live without giving away the client's next concession.
tasks.human_edge: The agent hears what the other side will actually accept.

ambition.what: Before each call the agent decides which open point is tradable, using the client's written limit.

tasks.altitude: Negotiation calls stay. The agent gains the right to stop a call that would pass the client's limit.

reach.task: Set agency limits on price and condition concessions
reach.learn: Which concessions need the broker before the agent agrees

evidence.claim: Negotiating and selling stay with a person.
Client identification duties apply to Dutch makelaars before a transaction proceeds.
Prospect and client mail need a lawful basis.

assumptions: Focal role is the agent for one side. Boundary: from the latest two positions to a written note of what was just agreed. The purchase agreement is a later task.

Structured fields are the open terms: price, completion date, inclusions, and financing deadline, plus the client's max concession on each. The client produces the limit. Fallback: the agent types limits from a call.
Use {CRM} activities before a new store. Runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers the limit form when the agency adds a term.
Recording the call would need works-council consent under the Dutch rule in the digest. This design does not record calls.
unknowns: Whether clients already state limits in writing.
Whether both sides share one file or only mail.
research_questions: How often does a call end with a concession outside the written limit?
What share of positions exist only in mail?

incremental.description: Keep the concession-limit form aligned with the agency's current terms

approvals.approved_version: trade limits version taken into the call

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: positions are only in mail and most calls reopen the limits, so prep saving disappears. High: limits are already on the file and only the note shrinks. The call stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Chase lenders, inspectors and the notary so closing conditions are met.

steps.what: Read conditions and deadlines out of the signed agreement.

loop.check: Agent compares each row to the clause
loop.stop: One pass; a clause with no date is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Condition wording is not a fixed table

steps.what: Send a reminder when a condition deadline is inside five days.
Read inspection, lender and notary replies that are not a yes or no.
Decide whether the condition is met, waived, or blocking.
Carry out the inspection or the loan decision.
Tell every party the decision and the next deadline.

tasks.design: Deadlines from the signed agreement sit on a {WORKFLOW} checklist. Reminders go out only for the list version the agent checked. Reports that are not a clear yes or no stay with the agent, and the client decides a waiver before anyone is told the file is clear.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conditions were tracked in mail and a spreadsheet, so a missed reply surfaced at the closing table.
tasks.enabler_now: Dates and named conditions can drive reminders. Judging a bad survey cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a defect or a loan clause is enough to stop the sale.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which defect the buyer will live with.

ambition.what: Each condition is marked met, waived, or blocking on its deadline, not in the week of completion.

tasks.altitude: The agent spends less time chasing silence and more time on the reports that are unclear. Waiver rights stay with the agent and the client.

reach.task: Decide which defects block an agency closing
reach.learn: The broker's rule for when a defect must go back to the client

evidence.claim: Purchase agreements can be filled from CRM fields, which gives the condition list a stable source.
Monitoring contract deadlines as dated reminders is a rules task.
Wwft identification should be complete before completion.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent coordinating completion. Inspectors, lenders and the notary are suppliers. Their work is not the agent's saving.
Boundary: from the signed agreement to a status that every party has been told. Funds movement is the notary's later step.
Fields: condition name, responsible party, deadline, status. Producer is the signed agreement. Fallback: the agent types a clause the extract leaves blank.
Configure reminder rules on {WORKFLOW} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours covers new condition types and reminder copy. A waived item is not auto-cleared.
Dutch Wwft applies to makelaars as named in the digest.
unknowns: Which conditions the lender and the notary already track in their own portals.
How often a survey is a clear pass.
research_questions: What share of conditions miss their date today?
Who is allowed to waive a defect, the agent or only the client?

incremental.description: Add condition types and reminder text when the standard agreement changes
Supplier still writes the inspection report

approvals.approved_version: condition list version the agent checked
condition decision on that report set
status update for the decision version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most replies are narrative reports, so reminders save little and every item needs a decision. High: most replies are a clear status and only exceptions are read. Supplier inspection time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise the client on price, market, mortgage context and legal duties.

steps.what: Build a comparables table and a model value for this home.
Judge which sales belong and set the range the agent will say.
Explain the range, the mortgage context and the legal duties.
Send a short written range the client can keep.

loop.input: Approved range and the questions asked in the meeting
loop.output: Advice note with each figure tied to a comparable or a field
loop.check: Agent removes any figure that has no source row
loop.stop: One draft; unsourced sentences are dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow this home, not a generic market paragraph

tasks.design: A {BI} table lines up recent sales and a model value. The agent drops the sales that do not fit and sets the range, then explains it in person. The written note cites only that range and is sent after the agent edits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparables were copied into a document by hand, and the range was only spoken.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained sales table can be filtered. Choosing the range still needs the visit and the client.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which difference a buyer will pay for, and not treating a model value as a loan figure.
tasks.human_edge: The agent has seen the street and the client's real constraint.

ambition.what: Every advice meeting starts from a written range, including a client who only asked a quick price question.

tasks.altitude: Meetings stay. The agent can decline to quote a figure that is not on the checked table.

reach.role: securities and financial services sales agent
reach.task: Explain a financing condition the buyer still has to satisfy
reach.learn: Which financing questions must be handed to a licensed adviser

evidence.claim: An automated valuation is tested against sale prices and is not for mortgage lending.
A large buyer left home buying after an inventory write-down it blamed on price forecasts.
A house valuation is not treated as credit scoring under the cited AI Act point.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from recent sales to a signed advice note. The agent does not issue a mortgage offer.
Fields: address, size, type, sale date, sale price, and the model value. Producer is the sales record. Fallback: the agent adds a sale the table missed.
Use the {BI} dataset before a new model. A paid valuation feed is a run cost the customer confirms. Feed runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 4 hours covers area filters and the sentences the note is allowed to use.
The model value is context, not a loan appraisal. National rules decide who may advise on mortgages. The agent signs the note; a draft is not sent as an unsigned bot message.
unknowns: Whether the brokerage already pays for a valuation feed.
Which mortgage questions clients ask the agent today.
research_questions: How often is the spoken price different from the model value?
Does the client keep a written range today?

incremental.description: Refresh area filters and allowed note sentences when the market shifts

approvals.approved_version: advice range version explained in the meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the agent rebuilds comparables by hand because the feed misses local sales, and the meeting is unchanged. High: the table is usable and only the note shrinks. The range decision stays. A forecast error, as in the cited inventory write-down, is why the high case stays well below the mechanical saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still visits and seller meetings. Packs, deadlines and price tables are ready beforehand. The agent can hold an offer, a concession, or a price that is not on a checked version.
reach: Real estate brokers: set agency limits on concessions and defects
Insurance sales agents: see a financing condition that still needs a licensed adviser
skills_to_grow: Reading a comparables table without treating it as a loan value
role.ambitious_version: Every seller meeting starts from a versioned offer, every deadline has an owner, and every price conversation starts from a range the agent is willing to sign.
